findings.summary: A custom tooltip run whose field expression is EXACTDATE(<date field>) makes Tableau Cloud render the whole worksheet blank (1586x32).
findings.workaround: Reference the bare date fields in the tooltip runs; the tooltip text aggregates them at the month level, which is only cosmetic.
findings.upstream_note: The emitted tooltip XML is a valid continuous [none:...:qk] reference; the blank Cloud render is Cloud-specific and unverifiable locally.

findings.summary: Combining axis_style.encodings with the folded dual-axis builder and a row Detail field blanked the Cloud render in diagnostics.
findings.workaround: Set only axis_style.per_field titles; leave the folded axis defaults alone.
findings.upstream_note: Case-local authoring choice: leave the folded dual-axis defaults and set only axis_style.per_field titles.
